instruction: I need you to stream this video URL: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/img_bipbop_adv_example_ts/master.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using a different Apple HLS test stream (advanced example with TS). Uses the same evaluator logic (is_vlc_playing) which checks VLC status XML for the URL. The evaluator verifies that VLC is in 'playing' state and the URL matches the expected stream URL.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator checks both VLC playing state and URL match
Correct getter logic: get_vlc_playing_info extracts VLC status via HTTP interface correctly
Robust metric logic: is_vlc_playing implements multiple URL comparison methods including HLS stream handling where VLC may show filename instead of full URL
Expected value is correct: The expected URL exactly matches the instruction requirement
Runtime feasibility: VLC HTTP interface is enabled in config, getter can access status at evaluation time
Good edge case handling: Metric handles URL variations, filename-only displays for HLS streams, and logs warnings for mismatches
